name_reason: Compliant. Prefix data_fd2_battle_ (battle core table) + domain summon_spell + family qualifier 8slot (shared with sibling tables data_fd2_battle_summon_spell_8slot_visibility_table @0x523E1 and _y_offset_table @0x523E8 and reader fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot; 8slot is the orbit's conceptual slot count -- the frame-counter init loop runs i in 0..7 -- while the per-slot geometry tables cover 7 entries) + descriptor row_multiplier_table accurately names a table whose entries multiply row_stride. Reflects data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix tied to 0x52404).
purpose: Per-slot row-stride multiplier table for the summon-spell stage-0 (pre-animation) 8-slot orbit setup; multiplies row_stride to bias each slot vertically.
logic_summary: Read-only int32[7]. Reader fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot @0x26152 bulk-copies all 7 dwords to a stack buffer (MOV ECX,0x7; MOV ESI,0x52404; REP MOVSD), then in the per-slot blit math does MOV EDX,[row_multiplier[slot]]; IMUL EDX,EBP (signed multiply by row_stride); ADD EDX,(origin_y + y_offset[slot]) to form the slot's blit Y coordinate: y = row_multiplier[slot]*row_stride + origin_y + y_offset[slot]. Sibling of the visibility mask @0x523E1 and y-offset table @0x523E8.
element_semantics: Each entry = a signed multiplier applied to the per-slot vertical row stride. Values { 0, -10, -20, 0, -15, -5, 0 }: negative entries lift that slot upward by N*row_stride px (IMUL is signed); 0 entries keep the slot on the baseline.
comment_original_issue: The pre-declaration line read '/* Non-const for the same reason as the visibility sibling above. */' which contradicted the actual 'const int32' declaration AND was doubly wrong because the visibility sibling is itself const (its block states const: read-only in-game). The descriptive block above was otherwise accurate and assembly-verified.
notes: Verified against disassembly of reader @0x26152: REP MOVSD with ECX=0x7 from 0x52404 confirms 7 elements x 4 bytes; IMUL EDX,EBP confirms signed multiply by row_stride. Memory image @0x52404 hex 00000000 f6ffffff ecffffff 00000000 f1ffffff fbffffff 00000000 = { 0,-10,-20,0,-15,-5,0 }, matches src initializer. Only DATA/READ xref pair is the copy at 0x26193/0x26198 in fd2_tick_summon_spell_setup_pre_animation_8slot; no writers -> const correct. Ghidra symbol name byte-identical to src. Ghidra plate was null (empty); created concise plate from src conclusion. Also referenced by anisummn.c test harness via memcpy (read-only).
